taṇhuppāda.p: [Taṇhā+uppāda] (pu) CL=7 (1) it is happening craving. (2) Craving which happened. (3) It is cause of happening craving  that is (four articles they are robe, alms, monastery, medicine).
a: တဏှုပ္ပါဒ(ပု)
